title: "Fixed-cohort full benchmark comparison"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    number_sections: true
---

This notebook compares the corrected fixed-cohort HiCBZIP results with Raw,
scHiCImpute, scHiCluster, Fast-Higashi, and Higashi. The manuscript comparison uses depth-matched inputs for HiCBZIP and scHiCImpute.

The HiCBZIP and Raw results use the fixed 150-cell cohort. scHiCImpute uses
only its 146 nonempty outputs and is labeled accordingly. The three integrated
methods retain their established benchmark runs. Only load SCORE embedding
pickles from trusted sources.

## 1. Setup

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)

required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "purrr", "tibble", "readr", "ggplot2",
  "jsonlite", "reticulate", "hdf5r"
)
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop("Missing R packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

output_dir <- file.path(result_root, "manuscript_summaries")

version_labels <- c(primary_depth_matched = "Depth matched")
```

## 2. Metric-file manifest

```{r metric_helpers}
metric_file <- function(version, workflow, method, run) {
  run_id <- sprintf("%02d", run)
  workflow_id <- tolower(workflow)
  metric_name <- paste0(workflow_id, ".json")

  if (method == "Raw") {
    dataset <- if (workflow == "InnerProduct") {
      paste0("oocyte_zygote_raw_nm_pairs_r", run_id)
    } else {
      paste0("oocyte_zygote_raw_nm_pairs_snapatac_no_idf_r", run_id)
    }
    return(file.path(
      reported_root, "server_json_runs_nm", dataset,
      "1M", workflow_id, metric_name
    ))
  }

  if (method %in% c("HiCBZIP-GB(NB)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)")) {
    model <- if (method == "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)") "gbnb" else "nm"
    representation <- "depth_matched"
    dataset <- paste0(
      "oocyte_zygote_", model, "_", representation,
      "_fixed150_", workflow_id, "_r", run_id
    )
    return(file.path(
      result_root, "outputs/fixed150_score/external_imputation",
      workflow_id, representation, model, "results", dataset,
      "1M", workflow_id, metric_name
    ))
  }

  if (method == "scHiCImpute") {
    representation <- "depth_matched"
    dataset <- paste0(
      "oocyte_zygote_schicimpute_", representation,
      "_complete146_", workflow_id, "_r", run_id
    )
    return(file.path(
      result_root, "outputs/complete146_score/external_imputation",
      workflow_id, representation, "schicimpute", "results", dataset,
      "1M", workflow_id, metric_name
    ))
  }

  stop("Unsupported external method: ", method)
}

integrated_file <- function(method, run) {
  run_id <- sprintf("%02d", run)
  if (method == "scHiCluster") {
    return(file.path(
      reported_root, "oocyte_zygote_schicluster_10runs",
      paste0("oocyte_zygote_schicluster_r", run_id), "1M",
      "schicluster%3Avc_sqrt_norm,convolution,random_walk",
      "schicluster%3Avc_sqrt_norm,convolution,random_walk.json"
    ))
  }
  if (method == "Fast-Higashi") {
    return(file.path(
      reported_root, "oocyte_zygote_fast_higashi_10runs",
      paste0("oocyte_zygote_fast_higashi_r", run_id),
      "1M/fast_higashi/fast_higashi.json"
    ))
  }
  if (method == "Higashi") {
    return(file.path(
      reported_root, "oocyte_zygote_higashi_10runs",
      paste0("oocyte_zygote_higashi_r", run_id),
      "1M/higashi/higashi.json"
    ))
  }
  stop("Unsupported integrated method: ", method)
}
```

```{r metric_manifest}
external_manifest <- crossing(
  version = names(version_labels),
  workflow = c("InnerProduct", "SnapATAC"),
  method = c("Raw", "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)", "scHiCImpute"),
  run = 1:10
) %>%
  mutate(
    pipeline = paste(workflow, method, sep = " + "),
    file = pmap_chr(
      list(version, workflow, method, run), metric_file
    )
  )

integrated_manifest <- crossing(
  version = names(version_labels),
  method = c("scHiCluster", "Fast-Higashi", "Higashi"),
  run = 1:10
) %>%
  mutate(
    workflow = "Integrated", pipeline = method,
    file = map2_chr(method, run, integrated_file)
  )

metric_manifest <- bind_rows(external_manifest, integrated_manifest) %>%
  mutate(
    seed = 2025L + run,
    exists = file.exists(file),
    size_bytes = ifelse(exists, file.info(file)$size, NA_real_)
  )

print(metric_manifest %>% count(version, pipeline, exists), n = Inf)
stopifnot(
  nrow(metric_manifest) == 110L,
  all(metric_manifest$exists), all(metric_manifest$size_bytes > 0)
)

write_csv(
  metric_manifest,
  file.path(output_dir, "full_benchmark_manifest_261031.csv")
)
```

## 3. Metric tables and boxplots

```{r metric_tables}
first_numeric <- function(x, field, path) {
  value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[[field]][1]))
  if (length(value) != 1L || !is.finite(value)) {
    stop("Missing or nonfinite ", field, " in ", path)
  }
  value
}

read_score_metrics <- function(path) {
  value <- jsonlite::fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  ari <- first_numeric(value, "best_ari", path)
  nmi <- first_numeric(value, "best_nmi", path)
  silhouette <- first_numeric(value, "best_silhouette", path)
  tibble(
    best_ari = ari, best_nmi = nmi,
    best_silhouette = silhouette,
    avgBio = mean(c(ari, nmi, silhouette))
  )
}

benchmark_metrics <- metric_manifest %>%
  mutate(values = map(file, read_score_metrics)) %>%
  select(version, workflow, pipeline, method, run, seed, values) %>%
  unnest(values)

benchmark_long <- benchmark_metrics %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(metric_levels),
    names_to = "metric", values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    version = factor(version, levels = names(version_labels)),
    pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipeline_levels),
    method = factor(method, levels = method_levels),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_levels)
  )

benchmark_summary <- benchmark_long %>%
  group_by(version, workflow, pipeline, method, metric) %>%
  summarize(
    runs = n(), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value),
    minimum = min(value), maximum = max(value), .groups = "drop"
  )

benchmark_rankings <- benchmark_summary %>%
  group_by(version, metric) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(rank_by_mean = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

print(benchmark_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)
print(
  benchmark_rankings %>%
    filter(rank_by_mean <= 5L) %>%
    select(version, metric, rank_by_mean, pipeline, mean, sd),
  n = Inf, width = Inf
)

write_csv(
  benchmark_metrics,
  file.path(output_dir, "full_benchmark_per_run_261031.csv")
)
write_csv(
  benchmark_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "full_benchmark_summary_261031.csv")
)
write_csv(
  benchmark_rankings,
  file.path(output_dir, "full_benchmark_rankings_261031.csv")
)
```

```{r metric_boxplots, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=3.2}
make_metric_plot <- function(version_id) {
  plot_data <- benchmark_long %>% filter(version == version_id)
  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = pipeline, y = value, fill = method, color = method)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.68, alpha = 0.70, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.32
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.55, alpha = 0.60,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.11, height = 0)
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(4.5, 8.5), linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.30
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = group_label_df,
      aes(x = x, y = 1.015, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, fontface = "bold", size = 2.25
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~metric, nrow = 1,
      labeller = labeller(metric = metric_labels)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      breaks = pipeline_levels,
      labels = unname(pipeline_labels),
      drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = method_colors, breaks = method_levels,
      labels = method_legend_labels, drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = method_colors, breaks = method_levels,
      labels = method_legend_labels, drop = FALSE
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Value", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold", size = 9,
        margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2)
      ),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.45
      ),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.10, "lines"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 7, angle = 35, hjust = 1, vjust = 1
      ),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.30),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.16, "in"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.14, "in"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 2),
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 3, b = 2, l = 2)
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE),
      color = "none"
    )
}
```

## 4. Run-1 PCA comparisons

```{r pca_helpers, include=FALSE}
read_reference <- function(path) {
  value <- read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cell_column <- names(value)[1]
  cluster_column <- if ("cluster" %in% names(value)) "cluster" else names(value)[2]
  value %>%
    transmute(
      cell = as.character(.data[[cell_column]]),
      cell_full = ifelse(grepl("\\.1M$", cell), cell, paste0(cell, ".1M")),
      celltype = as.character(.data[[cluster_column]])
    )
}

reference <- read_reference(reference_path)

read_pickle_pca <- function(path) {
  builtins <- reticulate::import_builtins(convert = FALSE)
  pickle <- reticulate::import("pickle", convert = FALSE)
  handle <- builtins$open(path, "rb")
  on.exit(try(handle$close(), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  object <- pickle$load(handle)

  z <- as.matrix(reticulate::py_to_r(object[["z"]]))
  cells <- as.character(reticulate::py_to_r(object[["cell"]]))
  if (nrow(z) != length(cells) && ncol(z) == length(cells)) z <- t(z)
  stopifnot(nrow(z) == length(cells), ncol(z) >= 2L)

  index <- match(cells, reference$cell_full)
  if (anyNA(index)) {
    index <- match(sub("\\.1M$", "", cells), sub("\\.1M$", "", reference$cell))
  }
  if (anyNA(index)) stop("Unmatched PCA cells in: ", path)

  pca <- prcomp(z, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
  tibble(
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1], PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    celltype = reference$celltype[index]
  )
}

read_h5ad_obs_col <- function(obs_group, key) {
  node <- obs_group[[key]]
  if (inherits(node, "H5Group")) {
    node_names <- names(node)
    if (all(c("codes", "categories") %in% node_names)) {
      codes <- as.integer(node[["codes"]]$read())
      categories <- as.character(node[["categories"]]$read())
      return(as.vector(categories[codes + 1L]))
    }
  }
  if (inherits(node, "H5D")) {
    values <- node$read()
    attributes <- tryCatch(
      hdf5r::h5attr_names(node),
      error = function(e) character(0)
    )
    if ("categories" %in% attributes) {
      categories_object <- hdf5r::h5attr(node, "categories")
      categories <- as.character(
        categories_object$dereference()[[1]]$read()
      )
      return(as.vector(categories[as.integer(values) + 1L]))
    }
    return(as.vector(as.character(values)))
  }
  stop("Unsupported H5AD obs encoding for: ", key)
}

read_h5ad_pca <- function(path) {
  h5 <- hdf5r::H5File$new(path, mode = "r")
  on.exit(h5$close_all(), add = TRUE)
  z <- as.matrix(h5[["obsm"]][["X_pca"]]$read())
  obs_names <- names(h5[["obs"]])
  label_key <- if ("celltype" %in% obs_names) {
    "celltype"
  } else if ("cluster" %in% obs_names) {
    "cluster"
  } else {
    obs_names[[1]]
  }
  celltype <- read_h5ad_obs_col(h5[["obs"]], label_key)
  if (nrow(z) != length(celltype) && ncol(z) == length(celltype)) z <- t(z)
  stopifnot(nrow(z) == length(celltype), ncol(z) >= 2L)
  tibble(PC1 = z[, 1], PC2 = z[, 2], celltype = celltype)
}

pca_metric_to_embedding <- function(metric_path) {
  file.path(dirname(metric_path), "embedding__0.pickle")
}
```


```{r pca_data}
pca_data <- pca_manifest %>%
  mutate(
    coordinates = map2(
      file, source_type,
      ~ if (.y == "h5ad") read_h5ad_pca(.x) else read_pickle_pca(.x)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(version, workflow, pipeline, method, coordinates) %>%
  unnest(coordinates) %>%
  group_by(version, workflow, pipeline, method) %>%
  mutate(retained_cells = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    method_label = recode(method, "scHiCImpute" = "HiCImpute"),
    panel = case_when(
      workflow == "Integrated" ~ paste0(
        method_label, "\n(Integrated)\n(n=", retained_cells, ")"
      ),
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        workflow, "\n", method_label, "\n(n=", retained_cells, ")"
      )
    )
  )

pca_counts <- pca_data %>%
  distinct(version, workflow, pipeline, method, retained_cells)
print(pca_counts, n = Inf)

write_csv(
  pca_counts,
  file.path(output_dir, "full_benchmark_pca_cell_counts_261031.csv")
)
```

```{r pca_plots, fig.width=15.0, fig.height=10.0}
panel_order_for <- function(version_id) {
  pca_data %>%
    filter(version == version_id) %>%
    distinct(pipeline, panel) %>%
    mutate(pipeline = factor(pipeline, levels = pipeline_levels)) %>%
    arrange(pipeline) %>%
    pull(panel)
}

make_pca_plot <- function(version_id, title) {
  panel_levels <- panel_order_for(version_id)
  plot_data <- pca_data %>%
    filter(version == version_id) %>%
    mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = panel_levels))

  pca_axis_labels <- function(x) {
    finite_x <- x[is.finite(x)]
    if (length(finite_x) > 0L && max(abs(finite_x)) < 0.05) {
      sprintf("%.1e", x)
    } else {
      sprintf("%.1f", x)
    }
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = celltype)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.85) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 4, scales = "free", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4),
      labels = pca_axis_labels
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4),
      labels = pca_axis_labels
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "Cell type") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "plain"),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

p_pca_primary <- make_pca_plot(
  "primary_depth_matched",
  "PCA embeddings across imputation and embedding pipelines"
)
```
